jobs.title: Project Engineering Manager - Core Spreads Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Location: Pratau, Germany

 On-site

 About the position 

 As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice (by travelling) factories. The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance. The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, in accordance with company engineering standards, and in full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, GMP, and regulatory requirements.

 You will:

 
 Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.

 Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.

 Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.

 Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.

 Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.

 Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.

 Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.

 Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.

 Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.

 Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.

 Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.

 Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.

 Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.

 Facilitate effective communication between sites, functions, and project teams to enable timely decision-making, resource availability, and smooth project execution during factory operations.

 Ensure all project activities comply with company engineering standards, site safety rules, contractor management requirements, food safety standards, quality systems, GMP requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

 Lead or support Management of Change (MoC) processes, ensuring that technical, operational, safety, quality, environmental, and financial impacts are appropriately assessed, documented, approved, and implemented.

 Promote a strong safety and compliance culture by ensuring that appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, contractor supervision, and safe start-up practices are in place.

 Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.

jobs.description:
About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

 

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Shape and deliver solutions: Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions. 
  • Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery: Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes. 
  • Work through ambiguity: Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve. 
  • Own product direction: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability. 
  • Collaborate across stakeholders: Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives. 
  • Be developer-obsessed: Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience.

jobs.description:
Purpose of the Position 

As Product Manager, Publisher Payments, you will own and evolve Awin's global publisher payments experience, ensuring publishers are paid accurately, on time, and through payment methods that best meet their needs. 

You will shape how Awin delivers seamless payment experiences across countries, currencies and regulatory environments, balancing compliance, operational efficiency and customer experience. You will identify opportunities to simplify payment journeys, improve transparency and trust, and help publishers get paid with confidence, wherever they are in the world. 

Working closely with product, engineering, finance, support, operations and compliance teams, you will define and deliver solutions that create value for publishers, support business growth and enable Awin to scale its global payments capabilities. 

 

Key Tasks

  • Evolve Awin’s publisher payments experience, ensuring payments are accurate, timely and trusted by publishers across the globe
  • Define, prioritize and deliver product initiatives that improve the publisher payments experience, end-to-end
  • Identify payment-related pain points and opportunities through data, customer feedback and market insights, translating them into clear product outcomes
  • Drive the evolution of Awin’s global payments capabilities, supporting different countries, currencies, payment methods and regulatory requirements
  • Lead discovery activities to understand publisher needs, validate assumptions and ensure solutions solve genuine customer problems
  • Use data, customer insights and business context to prioritize opportunities, measure impact and continuously improve payment performance and user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across product, engineering, finance and operations to align on priorities and deliver improvements to the publisher payments experience
  • Partner closely with Finance, Operations, Compliance and Engineering teams to deliver payment solutions that balance customer experience, regulatory requirements and operational efficiency. 

 

Skills & Expertise 

  • 3+ years of experience in product management, preferably in a SaaS environment 
  • Proven experience of launching, scaling and improving products that create value for customers and the business 
  • Strong product mindset, with experience identifying customer problems, defining outcomes and prioritising opportunities 
  • Great stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technology teams 
  • Analytical and data-driven approach to problem solving and decision making 
  • Customer-centric mindset, with a passion for understanding user needs and improving experiences 
  • Strong understanding of the full product lifecycle, from discovery to delivery and iteration

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job description Who we are  
Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. Our newest therapy, Kranus Mictera, treats urinary incontinence in women, a condition that affects one in three women and that almost no onetakes seriously. Our therapies are built together with leading clinicians and scientists, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers, whichmeans everything you ship reaches patients with a real diagnosis instead of a wellness audience. We are ~50 people, everyone here owns outcomes ratherthan tickets, and AI is a settled part of how we work, so you won't be stuck in 2022 tooling here. One platform, many therapies, 3 countries. Small team. Big impact. If you live and breathe change, you will feel at home here.

 The Role 
As our Product Manager in charge of our consumer-facing Digital Therapeutics, you will lead the way to transform our platform of therapies from good to first-class with taste. Set a new pulse for healthcare!

 

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain.

Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. 

A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.

You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. 

 

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four
  • Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard
  • Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities
  • Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity
  • Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature
  • Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service

 

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • You have owned a coverage, completeness or data quality metric as your primary objective, and can say what it went from, to what, and over how long
  • You have worked at millions-of-records scale
  • You have moved that metric through teams that did not report to you, setting interfaces, contracts and SLAs with partner teams
  • You have shipped under a hard regulatory or consent constraint, in health, finance or identity, with privacy and consent by design
  • You have real technical depth: you have owned a data platform component as a product, a feature store, a context or profile service, or an identity layer. 
  • You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • You have had a data quality problem surface only once it reached a downstream consumer, and you changed how you worked because of it
  • You have built a completeness or quality definition and made an organisation adopt it
  • You have worked on interoperability, health data standards, or identity and account models

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children
  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally.

Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first.
 This role stewards that platform's product direction.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Product Management 
 Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path.

 Streamline orchestration and scheduling - bring fragmented scheduling tools together into one system every team reaches for by default, and use AI-assisted tooling to migrate jobs faster, with less manual engineering effort.

 Drive data ingestion and replication - define what self-service ingestion looks like for teams who want to bring their own data onto the platform, and build toward that.

 Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step.

 Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on.

 Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it.

 Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person.

 
 Execution and Individual Contribution

 Who You Are

 Product-Market-Fit: Steuerung des Produkts von Problem-Fit über Solution-Fit bis hin zum Product-Market-Fit unter Nutzung schlanker, hypothesengeleiteter und iterativer Methoden.

 KPI-Tracking: Verfolgung und Analyse zentraler Lebenszyklus-KPIs (u. a. Konvertierung, Adoption, Churn, NPS, MRR/ARR, CAC und Feature-ROI).

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days) 
 
 The Mission
 At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.
 We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.
 We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.
 You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.
 
 What you will own
 You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.
 Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

 Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

 Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

 Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

 Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

 Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

 Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

 Who you are
 You are a full-stack product thinker.
 Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

 Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

 Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

 Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

 Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

 The Role
 You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.
 You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.
 You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.
 You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.
 If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.
 
 Why Fyxer?
 We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.
 Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

 Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

 Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

 Compensation: £120K – £180K • £120K – £180K Equity

jobs.title: (Senior) Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
What We're Building Towards
 At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.
 Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.
 We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

 What We're Looking For
 We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.
 Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.
 You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

 What You'll Build
 Own the plan for our hardware development projects, from concept and prototypes to release for series production

 Keep hardware, software, and data science development in sync: interfaces, test campaigns, integration milestones, and releases

 Prioritize the integration backlog together with our tech leads and align it with customer commitments

 Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality

 Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers

 Plan and coordinate system deployments together with Sales Engineering: installation scheduling, spare parts, and incident handling

 Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early

 Deliver clear, regular reporting on milestones, trial outcomes, and project status to leadership

 What You Bring
 3 to 5 years of experience in technical project management in a hardware development environment: machinery, medtech, robotics, optics, or comparable

 Solid understanding of hardware development, from prototyping to release for small series production

 Experience coordinating outsourced development work with manufacturers or key suppliers

 Enough understanding of software and data science to spot dependencies to the hardware and plan integration realistically

 Experience with project budgets and risk tracking

 Strong communication skills: you naturally become the connective tissue between engineers, partners, and leadership

 A structured, hands-on working style and an affinity for using AI tools in your daily workflow

 Fluent English. Fluent German is a strong plus for working with our partners and suppliers

 Willingness to travel occasionally to our partners

 Nice to have: experience with embedded systems, optics, or agile product ownership

 Not ticking every box? That's okay. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

 What You'll Get
 Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.
 Relocation Support: Moving to Munich? We help you find an apartment in the Werksviertel within walking distance of the office. We connect you with the right contacts and take the stress out of apartment hunting.
 Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Up to 50% remote work, depending on role and execution needs.
 Ownership: VSOPs (Virtual Stock Options) so you share in the value you help create.
 Time Off: 28 vacation days per year, plus December 24th and 31st off.

 Benefits & Growth
 Monthly meal budget for whatever keeps you going, from quick lunches to proper team dinners

 Monthly perks budget to spend where it actually matters to you — fitness, mobility, or the occasional "I earned this" purchase

 Annual learning budget to invest in

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - B2B Software (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei uns sitzt Marketing nicht am Ende der Kette. Du bist von Anfang an dabei: wenn Produkte entstehen, wenn Kunden gewonnen werden und wenn Argumente gebaut werden, die standhalten.

 Aufgaben

 
 Positionierung und Messaging. Du machst klar, warum Product Mining eine eigene Kategorie ist, warum Soley und warum jetzt. Du entwickelst differenzierte Botschaften je Entscheiderrolle und grenzt uns belastbar ab: gegen BI, gegen Beratungsprojekte, gegen generische AI und gegen den kundenseitigen Eigenbau mit SAP und Power BI.

 Business Case. Du baust ein Value-Modell mit dokumentierten Annahmen, das ein Account Executive im Kundengespräch selbst rechnen kann und das einem kritischen Einkauf oder CFO standhält.

 Sales Enablement. Du entwickelst die Materialien, die im echten Enterprise-Gespräch funktionieren: Solution Briefs, One-Pager, Executive Presentations, Battlecards, Einwandbehandlung, Success Stories. Du schreibst sie selbst.

 Launches. Du führst neue Solutions von der Positionierung über die interne Readiness bis zur Markteinführung. Du entscheidest, was eine echte Markteinführung verdient und was eine Release Note ist.

 Stimme des Kunden. Du führst Kundeninterviews und Win/Loss-Gespräche selbst, statt sie dir berichten zu lassen, und leitest daraus ab, was sich an unserer Story ändern muss.

 Freigabe der Botschaft. Alle kundenwirksamen Aussagen laufen über dich, auch Anzeigen- und Landingpage-Texte, die von der Kampagnenseite kommen. Du hältst die Kategorie konsistent, ohne zur Bremse zu werden.

 Wirkung messen. Du definierst je Maßnahme eine Wirkungshypothese und die passende Kennzahl. Bei uns regiert das Daten-Dashboard, nicht das Bauchgefühl. Reichweite und Klicks sind für uns keine Erfolgsmaßstäbe.

 
 Was die Rolle nicht ist Damit du weißt, worauf du dich einlässt:

 
 Du betreibst keine Kanäle. Paid Media, Kampagnenbudget, Landingpage-Bau, E-Mail-Strecken, Messeorganisation und die Funnel-Logik in HubSpot liegen auf der Demand-Generation-Seite. Du lieferst die Botschaft dafür und gibst sie frei.

 Du bist keine interne PowerPoint-Agentur und arbeitest nicht auf Zuruf.

 Du bist nicht für Corporate Brand, PR oder Employer Branding zuständig.

 Es gibt keine fertige Product-Marketing-Maschine, die du nur betreiben musst. Du baust sie.

 
 Zwei Kennzahlen teilst du dir ausdrücklich mit der Kampagnenseite: die Konversion von qualifizierten Leads in qualifizierte Opportunities und die Konversion unserer zentralen Website-Seiten. Beide bewegt keiner allein.

 Qualifikation

 Must have 

 
 4-8 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Software-Marketing, davon mindestens zwei Jahre im Product Marketing mit direkter Anbindung an den Vertrieb

 Erfahrung mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten, mehreren Entscheidern im Buying Center und langen Verkaufszyklen

 Fähigkeit, sich in komplexe technische Themen einzuarbeiten und das Wesentliche auf den Punkt zu bringen, ohne es zu verwässern

 du erstellst hochwertige Assets selbst, vom Konzept bis zur finalen Version

 Zahlenfestigkeit: du kannst einen Business Case aufbauen und gegen kritische Rückfragen verteidigen

 mindestens ein Beispiel, in dem deine Positionierungsarbeit eine Kennzahl bewegt hat, und du kannst sagen, welche

 sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau, sicher auch gegenüber Geschäftsführung und C-Level

 gute Englischkenntnisse

 
 Nice to have 

 
 Branchenkenntnisse aus Industrie, Maschinenbau oder diskreter Fertigung

 Erfahrung im PLM-, ERP- oder SAP-Umfeld oder mit Daten-, Analytics- und AI-Produkten

 Erfahrung darin, eine neue Kategorie oder ein neues Begriffsfeld im Markt zu besetzen

 frühere Sales- oder Presales-Erfahrung

 sicherer Umgang mit Design-Tools wie Adobe Creative Suite oder Canva

 Offenheit für AI-gestützte Workflows

 
 Benefits

 
 flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten

 Büro im Münchner Werksviertel im House of Communication

 spannende internationale Projekte mit gestaltendem Einfluss

 regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche

 internationales und diverses Team

 kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Obst im Büro

 Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft

jobs.description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.

 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June.

 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.

Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) 

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default 
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds 
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

What to expect

  • Strategy and roadmap: Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.

  • Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

  • Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

  • Ship small, iterate fast: Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.

  • Technical execution: Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.

  • Design for humans and agents: Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both

jobs.title: Product Manager - Discover
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar 

 BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. 
 

 Your Mission 

 As the Product Manager for the Discover squad, you will focus on the upper funnel of the passenger journey. Your mission is to capture global traffic via SEO and emerging LLM-based search (GEO), ensuring passengers have a seamless experience when they land on our platform. You will build a vision that maximizes conversion from all acquisition channels, prioritizing high-impact projects across our core markets.

 
 The Team 

 
 
 The Demand Team: The Discover squad is a core team of the Demand pillar, owning the end-to-end passenger experience alongside Search, Booking, Payment, and Post-booking.

 
 Your Squad: You will co-lead the Discover squad alongside an Engineering Manager. The squad consists of 6 front-end engineers.

 
 Internal Stakeholders: Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing Managers, Product Data, Product Design, and Business leads.

 

 Your Responsibilities 

 Shape the Discover strategy & roadmap: Define the Product and Engineering vision for the Discover scope, along with the appropriate KPIs to measure progress. You will take full responsibility for your scope from strategy to execution. 

 Drive top-funnel acquisition: Partner with the Marketing and SEO teams to define and deliver the acquisition roadmap. This includes adapting our architecture for the AI era to ensure our inventory is easily crawlable by LLMs and AI agents. 

 Maximize landing page conversion: Define and deliver a strategy to optimize the landing experience and maximize conversion from all channels. You will leverage AB tests to run experiments and drive our Land-to-Book conversion targets. 

 Navigate cross-functional alignment: Act as the go-to product person for all Discover topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions, and ensure alignment across Engineering, Marketing, Design, Data, and Business teams. 

 Manage the Busfor platform: Act as the referent Product Manager for Busfor, a standalone brand acquired and owned by BlaBlaCar operating in Eastern Europe 

 Your Qualifications 

 Experience: 3+ years of Product Management. An experience in top-of-funnel acquisition, growth, or SEO is preferred but not required. 

 Problem-Solving: Highly analytical with a proven track record of using A/B testing to deliver fast, incremental impact on conversion rates. 

 Stakeholder Influence: Strong interpersonal skills to navigate cross-functional relationships, gain buy-in, and clearly communicate prioritization decisions. 

 Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory. 

 If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application! 

 What we have to offer 

 2 to 3 days at the office per week

 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

 Financial support for home office equipment

 Minimum 25 days holiday per year

 Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

 Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

 Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like. 

 A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition.

 A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager.

 Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders.

 30-minute video call with the CPO for final validation

 Our hiring process lasts on average 20-25 days and offers usually come within 48 hours.
 BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What is Jedox? Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, helping organizations plan, analyze, and drive business performance with confidence. More than 2,000 companies worldwide, from ambitious mid-sized businesses to global enterprises, rely on Jedox to streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
Recognized as a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, Jedox combines powerful planning capabilities with a modern cloud platform that enables businesses to adapt quickly and make informed decisions. At Jedox, we believe in innovation, impactful results, people centricity, and the power of #OneTeam to help our customers succeed.

 Your Responsibilities As Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of key platform experiences including navigation, onboarding, user access, and cloud administration. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture, you will drive improvements that enhance usability, customer trust, and platform scalability, helping shape how thousands of users experience Jedox every day.

 What You'll Do Own the product strategy and roadmap : Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Platform Navigation, BaseUI, and Cloud Console capabilities.
 Lead discovery and product validation: Conduct user research, gather stakeholder input, analyze customer needs, and validate opportunities to ensure impactful product investments.
 Shape the platform experience: Improve navigation, onboarding, login experiences, session management, and integrations with platform services such as analytics and feature flagging solutions.
 Drive Cloud Console evolution:  Enhance the self-service administration experience, enabling IT teams to efficiently manage environments, users, permissions, and access controls.
 Manage end-to-end product delivery: Guide initiatives from concept through delivery, launch, and communication while ensuring high-quality execution and measurable outcomes.
 Prioritize and make trade-offs: Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform goals to make informed product decisions.
 Partner with Engineering and Architecture: Collaborate closely with technical leaders to align short-term delivery with sustainable platform architecture and scalability.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.
  • Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.
  • Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.
  • Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.
  • Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.

We expect you to have:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.
  • Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.

  • Direct experience shipping a search or ranking change end to end, including how it was evaluated and what happened after it shipped.

jobs.title: Product Manager confirmé H/F - SaaS - Fintech
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 
 N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme une référence sur le marché français. 
 N2F est une plateforme complète de Spend Management (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs, budget), conçue pour simplifier le quotidien des entreprises grâce à une expérience fluide, intuitive et 100 % connectée (web et mobile). 
 Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités , nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. 
 Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Product Manager confirmé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Produit et prendre la responsabilité d’un domaine fonctionnel clé de notre plateforme. Le terrain de jeu est vaste et les défis nombreux : internationalisation, intelligence artificielle, agents, automatisation des workflows, interconnectivité, refonte fonctionnelle et amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur. 
 
 Tes principales missions : 
 Rattaché(e) à la VP Product, tu seras responsable d’un domaine fonctionnel de notre plateforme et de son évolution à long terme. 
 Stratégie de Produit : 
 Définir et porter la vision de ton domaine produit. 

 Comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients, des utilisateurs et des équipes internes. 

 Analyser les tendances du marché, la concurrence et les évolutions technologiques afin d’identifier les meilleures opportunités de développement. 

 Participer à l’identification et à l’évaluation de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’IA, à l’automatisation et aux agents. 

 Gestion du Cycle de Vie du Produit : 
 Construire et piloter la roadmap de ton périmètre. 

 Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les opportunités en fonction de leur impact utilisateur et business. 

 Superviser le cycle de vie complet des fonctionnalités, de la discovery au lancement avec le Product marketing. 

 Mesurer les résultats et ajuster les orientations en fonction des retours terrain et des données. 

 Développement de Produit : 
 Piloter la conception et le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités avec les équipes Product Design et Engineering. 

 Garantir une expérience utilisateur simple, intuitive et performante. 

 Valider les solutions proposées grâce à des tests utilisateurs, des analyses de données et des expérimentations. 

 Veiller à délivrer des solutions pragmatiques, robustes et créatrices de valeur. 
 

 Le travail collaboratif est au cœur du rôle : 
 Travailler étroitement avec les équipes Sales, Customer Success et Support afin de comprendre les enjeux clients. 

 Communiquer régulièrement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes. 

 Favoriser l’alignement autour des priorités produit. 

 Participer à la promotion du produit en interne et en externe. 

 Contribuer à la diffusion de la culture Produit au sein de l’entreprise. 

 
 Ce que l’on va attendre de toi : 
 Tu disposes d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Manager, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS B2B. 

 Tu sais appréhender des problématiques métier complexes et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces. 

 Tu maîtrises les méthodologies agiles et les bonnes pratiques Produit. 

 Tu es capable de piloter un sujet en autonomie et d’embarquer les équipes autour de tes projets. 

 Tu sais arbitrer, prioriser et faire des choix pragmatiques et orientés impact. 

 Tu as déjà mené des projets d’envergure impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes. 

 Tu possèdes d’excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration. 

 Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et tu cherches à comprendre les sujets en profondeur avant de prendre des décisions. 

 Tu disposes d’un esprit analytique fort tout en gardant une forte orientation utilisateur. 

 Une sensibilité forte à l’IA est attendue 
 Tu t’intéresses activement aux évolutions de l’intelligence artificielle et à leurs applications concrètes dans les produits SaaS. 

 Tu utilises régulièrement des outils tels que ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini ou des assistants IA similaires dans ton quotidien professionnel. 

 Tu sais identifier les opportunités où l’IA, les LLM, l’OCR ou les agents peuvent apporter une valeur tangible aux utilisateurs. 

 Tu sais distinguer les effets de mode des usages réellement créateurs de valeur. 

 
 Tu es bilingue Français / anglais. 
 

 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 
 Rejoindre une entreprise rentable, en forte croissance et ambitieuse à l’échelle européenne. 

 Travailler sur un produit utilisé par plus d’un million d’utilisateurs à travers le monde. 

 Évoluer dans une équipe Produit structurée composée de Product Managers, Product Designers et Product Marketing Manager. 

 Contribuer à des sujets stratégiques mêlant SaaS, finance, IA et automatisation. 

 Bénéficier d’un environnement collaboratif où les idées sont éco

jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation 
 BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.
 Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.
 We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (if you are not located in the Zurich area), the role will be based remotely from Germany or Austria or onsite in Zurich.
As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month — these visits are financially supported by BLP.

 Your Mission 
 As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.
 If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

 Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

 Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

 Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation.

 Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

 Feed the product loop — translate feedback into long-term improvements to continuously evolve our platform.

 
 What We’re Really Looking For 
 The following key attributes ensure success in this role:
 Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

 Managing Ambiguity – You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

 Growth Mindset – You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

 Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

 Customer-First Mentality – You think beyond implementation — you care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

 
 What You Bring 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

 Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

 Strong analytical and communication skills — you can translate business needs into technical action.

 Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

 Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus

 Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

 
 Benefits 
 High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

 Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

 Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

 Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

 Employee ownership – be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

 Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

 Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Storage & Networking
jobs.description:
About our team: 
 Radiant is at the forefront of AI infrastructure, revolutionising the connection between software and hardware for the AI era. Our mission is to empower AI teams with scalable, secure, and efficient infrastructure solutions that support seamless model training, deployment, and scaling.
 Join a team operating some of the world’s most advanced high-performance computing infrastructure. As a Cloud Support Engineer, you will support cutting-edge GPU and CPU platforms — including the latest NVIDIA architectures — powering dense, large-scale compute environments used for AI, machine learning, and next-generation workloads.
 This is an opportunity to build expertise at the forefront of modern infrastructure, where reliability, scale, and performance matter every day. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers across a globally distributed organisation that values openness, inclusion, technical excellence, and continuous learning.
 We move quickly, solve meaningful challenges, and give people the space to make an impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with advanced technology, and want to help shape the future of high-performance compute, you’ll find both challenge and opportunity here.
 Job Summary: 
 As a Senior/Principal Product Manager – Storage & Networking, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the storage and networking capabilities underpinning Radiant’s GPU platform.
 You’ll work across bare-metal GPU clusters, Kubernetes, high-performance storage, data-centre networking, infrastructure inventory, automation, and observability, partnering closely with engineering, SRE, infrastructure, networking, and operations.
 This is a highly technical product role focused on ensuring GPU workloads have reliable, high-throughput, low-latency infrastructure at scale.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for storage and networking capabilities across the GPU platform.

 Define and prioritise storage capabilities based on customer, workload, performance, scale, and operational needs.

 Define and prioritise networking capabilities across the platform, from data centre infrastructure through to customer and workload connectivity.

 Partner with engineering to turn requirements into scalable, reliable platform services.

 Drive improvements in automation, self-service, observability, and operational efficiency.

 Define success metrics and use them to guide performance, reliability, capacity, and investment decisions.

 Qualifications: 
 Experience owning technical infrastructure, platform, storage, networking, or cloud products end-to-end.

 Experience working in data centre, bare-metal, cloud, HPC, AI infrastructure, or similar environments.

 Good understanding of modern storage technologies and architectures, and familiarity with file, object and block storage, WEKA, VAST, DDN, or similar.

 Good understanding of modern data centre and high-performance networking technologies, with familiarity with technologies such as Ethernet, InfiniBand, RDMA, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, and modern switching platforms.

 Familiarity with how storage and networking integrate with Kubernetes, bare-metal infrastructure, and large-scale compute platforms.

 Comfortable working closely with specialist engineers and making informed product and technical trade-offs.

 Strong prioritisation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

 Comfortable taking ambiguous infrastructure problems from discovery through to delivery.

 What you bring: 
 Systems thinking: Understand how compute, storage, networking, and platform services fit together.

 Product thinking: Turn infrastructure capabilities into clear, scalable services for customers and internal teams.

 Technical fluency: Work credibly with engineering without needing to be the domain expert.

 Prioritisation: Balance customer needs, performance, reliability, cost, and complexity.

 Ownership: Drive problems from discovery through delivery and adoption.

 Our values: 
 Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

 Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

 You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

 Why should you join us? 
 What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.
 Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:
 25 days of annual leave

 A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

 Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us bette

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.
  • Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.
  • Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.
  • Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.
  • Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent on high-scale search or ranking systems: web search, feed ranking at a large social platform, or a large ad engine.

 Mehrere parallele Workstreams und wechselnde Prioritäten bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept – du behältst den Überblick und setzt klare Schwerpunkte.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Financial Services
jobs.description:
About Mirakl: 

 Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

 For more information: www.mirakl.com .

 Mirakl in Numbers: 

 
 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

 Our Values: 

 Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

 Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

 
 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 
 The Team You'll Join

 You'll be part of our Financial Services product team. 
Together, you'll be driving the vision and execution of Mirakl's Financial Services products — from payments to embedded banking — to deliver outstanding value to marketplace operators and sellers worldwide.

 

 Your Impact

 Day-to -day, you will define with the Financial Services team the short and long-term roadmap for features within your scope:

 
 Identify new features and evolve existing ones to improve our clients' performance

 Build and maintain market and product analyses to identify functional gaps and investments to be made

 Manage, prioritize and optimize the functional backlog for the development team

 Collect customer feedback and anticipate their future needs

 Champion AI-native product practices: use our AI stack (Claude Cowork, Gemini, Dust, n8n) across discovery, spec writing and delivery, and proactively propose process improvements to increase the squad's velocity and quality.

 
 Collaborate and act as an ambassador with stakeholders:

 
 The Engineering Manager and development squad during design workshops

 Legal and business teams to launch the most viable solutions possible

 Data Science and Product Design teams to imagine new intelligent features and integrate them into the existing product ecosystem

 Marketing and Go To Market teams to drive launches, create and contribute to internal and external training and support materials

 Product and Recruitment teams to participate in recruiting and coaching Product Managers at Mirakl to nurture our Product culture

 
 What You'll Bring to the Role

 Experience: 

 
 4–6+ years of experience in Product Management

 Proven track record within a SaaS software company

 Significant experience with financial products and processes: factoring/cash advances, billing and collection mechanisms, payment systems, lending platforms, and embedded banking integrations

 Hands-on familiarity with API design and integration ecosystems

 Bonus: experience in a marketplace environment

 
 Skills: 

 
 Product roadmap ownership & backlog prioritization

 Financial product expertise (payments, lending, embedded banking)

 Data-driven decision-making

 Stakeholder communication & cross-functional collaboration

 Agile methodologies (SCRUM, Kanban)

 
 

 Tech Stack

 Product Management : ProductBoard, Heap Analytics, Jira, Figma, Hotjar, Zendesk, Slack, Google Suite
 AI : Claude Cowork, Google Gemini, Dust, n8n

 

 Languages

 
 French: Full professional proficiency

 English: Full professional proficiency
